ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act 2007, as amended, administered under the supervision of the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU); International Companies Act 1987, as amended (Registrar of International Companies; ss 6, 9, 10, 11, 12 and 28 regarding name clearance, registration, shareholder register and registered agent obligations); International Companies Rules 1988; International Companies Fees Regulations; United Nations financial sanctions measures as domestically gazetted under the relevant Samoan statutory instrument; Financial Intelligence Unit statutory reporting obligations for beneficial ownership, customer due diligence, and suspicious transaction reporting.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Private_Nominee_Friendly (nominee shareholders permitted under the International Companies Act 1987; the ultimate beneficial owner register is maintained privately by the licensed registered agent and is accessible to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit, the Registrar of International Companies, and competent authorities on lawful demand; no public online UBO register for International Companies)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or notary-certified bank authentication; Consular Legalization acceptable for non-apostille states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or licensed registered agent of the corporate beneficial owner's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille on the translator's notarial affidavit if the document is to be used before foreign authorities

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Ultimate Beneficial Owner attestation declaration (Form WS-UBO-1) identifying each natural person owning or controlling 25% or more of shares or voting rights
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Samoan registered agent under the International Companies Registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Private registered-agent attestation; Hague Apostille only when foreign judicial or regulatory use requires formal legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of the International Company, its directors, shareholders, registered agent, and all ultimate beneficial owners against: (1) UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (2) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List; (3) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (4) Samoa FIU gazetted domestic sanctions and watch lists; (5) Interpol and Samoan police notices; and (6) PEP databases covering domestic and foreign politically exposed persons, their family members and close associates per FATF Recommendations 12 and 22. Any PEP match, sanctions match, or adverse media hit requires enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, and documented source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence before incorporation proceeds.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Companies and International Companies Registry of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa; in-person filing at the MCIL Companies Office with online guidance through the official MCIL portal at www.mcil.gov.ws
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered legal name must be in Latin script (English or Samoan). Chinese characters may not constitute the registered legal name; a Chinese-language memorandum may be filed only as a certified translation with the definitive English text governing. Transliteration of Chinese names into English follows the pinyin (ISO 7098) standard, or a separate English trade name may be reserved with the Registrar. The mandatory name suffix is 'Limited' or 'Ltd'; names suggesting a different legal form, such as 'LLC', 'Foundation', or 'Trust', are prohibited.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name reservation is rejected, the applicant through its licensed registered agent may: (1) within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies, stating the grounds for appeal, accompanied by a statutory declaration and the prescribed appeal fee; (2) simultaneously submit up to three alternative reserved names; (3) receive a Registrar's decision within 10 business days; (4) if the appeal fails, petition the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour for ministerial review within 21 days of the Registrar's decision; the ministerial decision is administratively final. A granted name reservation may be extended once for an additional 30 days by paying the extension fee before the original reservation window lapses.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as the sole statutory registered office. Every International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Samoa at the premises of a licensed registered agent. Virtual or remote back-office administrative support is acceptable only as an ancillary service and does not satisfy the registered office or registered agent statutory requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk: estimated annual probability below 5% for an unannounced physical inspection of this entity class, given the low-risk standard AML tier of marine cargo damage surveying and the absence of regulated financial activity. The Registrar and the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit retain authority to conduct risk-based unannounced inspections of the licensed registered agent's premises and records.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, particularly sections 6 (Register of International Companies), 10 (Formation), 11-14 (Memorandum and Articles), 31 (Registered Office and Agent), and 34 (Share Capital); read with the Insurance Act 1976 for the licensed marine survey activity.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), International Companies Registry, Apia, Samoa (functions formerly administered by the Samoa International Finance Authority - SIFA).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation issued upon filing of the Application for Registration as an International Company (Form ICA-2), together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement under the International Companies Act 1987; the sole subscriber may subscribe for one ordinary share of WST 1.00 (approximately USD 0.40); no escrow account or capital deposit is mandated.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the subscriber shall subscribe for one ordinary share of WST 1.00, and the same is hereby allotted and issued to the subscriber in full satisfaction of the subscriber's capital obligation. (2) That the registered office of the Company shall be established at the office of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa, and the said agent is approved. (3) That [NAME] is appointed as Sole Director and [NAME] as Company Secretary, each with authority to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and file statutory returns. (4) That the filing of the marine cargo surveyor license application with the Central Bank of Samoa is authorized. (5) That all acts of the incorporator are ratified and confirmed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIL – Companies Registry (International Companies Section), Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through a licensed registered agent using Form ICA-1 and pay the prescribed name search fee. The proposed name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing company or reserved name and must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd.'.
required_dossiers: Form ICA-1 (Name Reservation Request)
Signed engagement letter with licensed registered agent
Passport copy of the intended subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or offensiveness, resubmit within 5 business days with an alternative name; the Registrar may also accept a written consent from the prior user.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent in Samoa / Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association in accordance with sections 11-14 of the International Companies Act 1987. The subscriber executes the documents before a notary public or in the presence of the registered agent; the capital table and registered office clause are included in the Articles.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association
Articles of Association
Subscriber consent form with capital undertaking
Registered office consent letter from the licensed agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar identifies drafting defects, file supplementary or amended documents within 14 days; each corrected page must be re-executed before a notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Application and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form ICA-2 (Application for Registration as an International Company) with the executed constitutional documents and pay the government filing fee of USD 500 (or WST equivalent) by wire or bank draft payable to the Ministry of Finance. The registered agent countersigns the application.
required_dossiers: Form ICA-2 (Application for Registration as an International Company)
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association (two notarized copies)
Registered agent consent letter
Proof of government fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries the application, provide a statutory declaration from the registered agent together with rectified documents within 10 business days; otherwise the application lapses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Appointment of First Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and assigns a unique company number. The registered agent files Form ICA-3 (Notice of Directors and Secretary) to record the first director and secretary of the Company.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Form ICA-3 (Notice of Directors and Secretary)
Registered office address confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains clerical errors, apply for administrative correction under section 12 of the Act; no re-filing fee is charged for Registrar errors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolution and Opening of Corporate Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or adopt a unanimous written resolution in lieu of meeting to approve the pro-forma resolution. Open the register of members, register of directors and officers, and register of charges; issue the share certificate to the subscriber.
required_dossiers: Written resolution of the first board
Register of members and register of directors
Share certificate issued to the subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any director requires a notarized consent, obtain and file the notarized consent with the registered agent within 7 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Corporate Bank Account and Payment Rail Integration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Commercial Bank in Samoa or Approved Offshore Banking Provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Certificate of Incorporation, first board resolution, director passport, and proof of registered office to the chosen bank for corporate account opening. Designate underwriter wire transfers and Wise as approved payment rails for client premium and claim settlement flows.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Board resolution approving bank signatories
Director passport and proof of address
AML/KYC forms and beneficial ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests further beneficial ownership information, provide an updated registry extract and a statutory declaration from the registered agent within 10 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Insurance Intermediary (Marine Claims Surveyor) License under the Insurance Act 1976 (Samoa), incorporating the marine cargo and hull claims inspection surveyor permit

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 (Registration) – low-impact office-based professional service; a full EIA Report is not required, but a brief EIA registration statement and environmental management plan must be submitted
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge to municipal sewer per Samoa Water Authority bylaws (BOD below 250 mg/L); no VOC-emitting industrial processes; solid waste, including contaminated cargo sampling debris, classified as non-hazardous commercial waste and removed by MNRE-accredited contractors in compliance with the Waste Management Act 2010

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Exit Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA); structural building load inspection and occupancy permit from the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure (MWTI) Building Division under the Samoa Building Code 2017; workplace occupational safety clearance registered with the Samoa Accident Compensation Corporation (ACC).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue of the Independent State of Samoa (MfR), Revenue House, Apia - online portal: Tax and Duty Administration System (TDAS), https://www.mfr.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the Samoa International Company (IC) with the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL); obtain the Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association; no minimum capital is required. Step 2: The IC is statutorily exempt from Samoan income tax, VAGST, stamp duty and all other Samoan taxes under the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), provided it transacts no local business with Samoan residents and holds no Samoan land; therefore no MfR income-tax registration is triggered. Step 3: If the IC opens a Samoan bank account, hires Samoan resident staff, or makes local purchases, apply to MfR for a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and, where WST 80,000 annual VAGST turnover is exceeded, file Form VAGST-01 for VAGST registration. Step 4: Obtain a written tax-exemption certificate from MfR evidencing the IC's exempt classification for presentation to foreign underwriters and paying banks. Step 5: Annually file the International Companies return and pay the flat MCIL licence fee; no corporate income tax return is required for exempt offshore activities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box classification election exists in Samoa. The International Company exemption is automatic by statute. Available elections: (i) the IC may elect by special resolution under the International Companies Act to convert into a domestic company, thereby becoming taxable under the Income Tax Act 2015; (ii) a person making exclusively zero-rated offshore supplies may elect not to register for VAGST, and a registered person may elect to apply for deregistration when turnover is below the WST 80,000 threshold; (iii) no hybrid mismatch or entity-classification election is enacted in Samoa; Samoa's international tax legislation does not provide a section 7701-style check-the-box analogue.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) under the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 1994 and VAGST Regulations
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 80,000 (Samoa tala) annual taxable turnover; non-resident International Companies supplying exclusively offshore marine insurance surveying services are outside the VAGST system regardless of turnover
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, digital stamping or API mandate applies in Samoa. Registered operators must submit VAGST returns electronically via MfR's Tax and Duty Administration System (TDAS) and issue prescribed-format paper or PDF invoices under the VAGST Regulations; no QR-coded fiscal receipts or government clearance platform is currently prescribed.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: VAGST zero-rating applies to goods exported and services supplied to a non-resident for use or consumption wholly outside Samoa, including marine hull, cargo and insurance damage survey services to foreign underwriters, P&I clubs and cargo owners, where the service is performed overseas or benefits a non-resident and no Samoan nexus exists; for the exempt International Company, offshore surveying income is wholly outside the VAGST net and 0% treatment is evidenced by the MfR exemption certificate rather than a VAT refund mechanism.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (where surveying equipment, dunnage samples or cargo remnants are physically exported from Samoa)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill or vessel call data confirming the offshore or international location of the surveyed hull/cargo
Signed marine survey report and service contract with the non-resident underwriter, broker or cargo owner
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 credit advice evidencing settlement by the non-resident in foreign currency within 180 days
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: MfR may audit VAGST records within the statutory assessment period and reclassify improperly zero-rated supplies as taxable at 15%, with penalty tax up to 50% of the assessed amount, statutory interest, and criminal fines up to WST 100,000 and/or imprisonment for fraudulent export claims. A Samoa International Company that breaches the non-resident nexus and transacts with Samoan residents may be stripped of its exemption, struck off, and fully assessed under the Income Tax Act 2015, with directors jointly and severally liable.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Fanuatupu o Samoa), the apex monetary authority and exchange control administrator under the Exchange Control Act 1976 and the Financial Institutions Act 2012; licensed commercial banks are designated authorised dealers for foreign exchange, WST market-making, and external-account administration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Current-account convertibility is available for services trade; capital-account convertibility is restricted for residents, but the Samoan International Company (IC) is non-resident and automatically permissive when holding external accounts in USD at an authorised dealer. The Samoan Tala (WST) is an administered currency with thin interbank liquidity; conversion to/from WST onshore is legal but subject to authorised-dealer rates and CBS reporting when the counterparty is a resident. For the marine insurance surveying IC, receipts are best denominated and retained in USD; profit and capital remittance to shareholders is unrestricted because the IC is non-resident, requiring no CBS dividend or surplus-remittance approval. The practical hurdles are liquidity, documentation (source of funds, purpose codes), and the bank's internal risk review, rather than statutory convertibility limits.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For residents, the Exchange Control Act 1976 and Regulations 1978 require exporters to repatriate proceeds within 90 days of shipment and surrender 100% of foreign-currency receipts to an authorised dealer (credited and converted to WST) unless exemption is granted; services exporters (including ISIC 5222 surveying) must receive settlement within 180 days of invoice and surrender any foreign currency. The Samoan International Company is non-resident: survey fees are receivable into a USD external account, are not Samoan exports, and are outside the statutory surrender and conversion ratios. The IC must not perform surveying for Samoan resident clients, which would re-characterise the fee as domestic business and trigger surrender, WST conversion, and the domestic-business restrictions of the International Companies Act 1988 (as amended).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual Fee Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies – Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after every anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of WS$50 per month; failure for 3 consecutive months exposes the International Company to a Registrar's warning and administrative strike-off without further notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Confirmation / AML/CFT Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit and licensed registered agent under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 January (or within 30 days of incorporation anniversary for newly incorporated companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance attracts fines up to WS$200,000 for the company and WS$50,000 for the registered agent, plus prohibition on the agent continuing to provide services.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies under the International Companies Act 2016 s.130 if the International Company carries on insurance, banking, or trust business. A survey-only marine claims inspection company is audit-exempt unless it holds a separate insurance underwriting licence or elects to appoint an auditor.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB, accepted as equivalent to Samoa IFRS-faithful accounting standards; records must be sufficient to explain transactions and financial position.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each anniversary the licensed registered agent must obtain a current declaration of beneficial owners from each shareholder, update the internal UBO register, and file a confirmation in the Annual Return. Any transfer of shares, issue of new shares, or disposal of control must be recorded within 14 days; failure to update is a continuing contravention under AML/CFT laws.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 – USD 5,000 (only required if entity becomes a licensed insurer; otherwise no audit fee applies)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% statutory corporate income tax rate for resident companies under Samoa's Income Tax Act 2015 (as amended). A Samoa International Company (IC) registered under the International Companies Act 2008 is statutorily tax-exempt, resulting in a 0% effective corporate income tax rate.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory tax exemption under the International Companies Act 2008: an IC and its non-resident shareholders are exempt from income tax, dividend and interest withholding tax, royalty withholding tax, stamp duties, and all existing or future Samoan taxes in respect of offshore profits, issued shares, transfers, and distributions, provided the IC carries on business wholly outside Samoa and continuously maintains a licensed Resident Agent and a registered office in Samoa.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (Form ICA-9) filed under the International Companies Regulations with the Registrar of International Companies through the Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) e-Registry online portal. No corporate income tax return (Form IR-1) is required because the IC is statutorily tax-exempt; the annual return and annual fee constitute the sole recurring compliance filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the anniversary of incorporation each year. The licensed Resident Agent must file the Form ICA-9 and settle the annual fee within 30 days after the anniversary date to avoid late surcharges and potential striking-off.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC registration number as shown on the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors must verify the exact registration number against the SIFA certificate; the Resident Agent enters it electronically in the e-Registry.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current company name and any former names appearing on the register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The name must match the certificate of incorporation exactly; any change of name requires prior approval of the Registrar obtained through the Resident Agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Street address of the registered office in Samoa, which must be the office of the licensed Resident Agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign address is not acceptable; all statutory notices and service of process are validly delivered at this Samoan address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, license number, and physical address of the licensed Resident Agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Resident Agent is the statutory and AML/CFT gatekeeper for the non-resident beneficial owner and holds custody of the company records in Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Share capital particulars: authorized capital, issued shares by class, par value, and paid-up amount.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For bearer or registered share structures, provide aggregate class data only; beneficial ownership particulars are captured confidentially through the Resident Agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, and residential addresses of all directors and corporate officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This register is confidential to the Registrar and not publicly searchable; nominee directors and non-resident principals must both be identified to the Resident Agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of offshore exclusivity: certification that the IC has not carried on business with Samoan residents and has not derived income from sources within Samoa during the fee year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Resident Agent obtains a signed declaration from the non-resident beneficial owner. For a marine insurance surveyor IC, this requires confirmation that all hull and cargo damage inspections and claims surveys are performed outside Samoan territory or solely for foreign underwriters.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Register of members: full legal name, jurisdiction of residence, and shareholding percentage of each shareholder.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident members must be identified by complete legal name and country of residence; incomplete beneficial ownership schedules expose the IC to AML review and striking-off.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification and signature of a director or the Resident Agent, with date and place of signing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Resident Agent's electronic signature is sufficient; the certifying officer attests to the truthfulness of Box 7 on penalty of criminal liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of Form ICA-9 incurs a monthly late fee as prescribed by the International Companies (Fees) Regulations, the annual license fee remains due, and an IC in arrears for two consecutive years is automatically struck off under the International Companies Act 2008. Restoration requires a court order, payment of all arrears and reinstatement fees, and may expose directors to personal liability for obligations incurred while struck off.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Income Tax Return (Form IR-1) filed with the Inland Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance, Apia. This form is included for completeness only; a tax-exempt IC is not required to file it unless the IC loses or never validly obtains exemption and is re-characterized as a resident company.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within one month after the end of the income year (the Samoa income year is the calendar year), or by such extended date as the Commissioner for Taxation may notify.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total assessable gross income derived from Samoa and worldwide sources.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Not applicable to a tax-exempt IC; relevant only where exemption has been revoked and the marine survey fees are re-assessed as Samoan-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt income, including income exempt under the International Companies Act 2008 where the exemption remains valid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC claiming exemption may record its offshore survey income here only in the transitional scenario of filing under protest; the full exemption operates automatically.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable at 27% after allowable deductions and loss offsets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A for non-resident IC shareholders; any re-characterization exposes the full income to 27% CIT plus 15% dividend WHT on deemed distributions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of Form IR-1 triggers a penalty of up to 5% of the tax payable per month or part thereof, together with late payment interest; failure to file allows the Commissioner to issue a default assessment and imposes an uplift penalty of up to 200% of the unpaid tax for intentional evasion.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends and distributions paid by an International Company to its non-resident shareholders, granted directly by the International Companies Act 2008 statutory exemption. For an ordinary resident Samoan company, the statutory dividend withholding tax rate is 15% under the Income Tax Act 2015.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not required for IC distributions: the 0% rate is conferred by domestic law and does not depend on a double taxation agreement or a tax residency certificate. In the residual scenario where a resident Samoan company pays a dividend to a non-resident treaty claimant, the payee must deliver a completed treaty relief application form and an annual Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the payee's home tax authority to the Samoan payer before payment; the payer must submit both documents to the Samoan Inland Revenue Division and retain them for the relevant assessment period. Samoa maintains a minimal DTA network, principally the Samoa-Australia Double Taxation Agreement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rates under the Income Tax Act 2015 are 15% on interest and 15% on royalties paid by a Samoan resident company to non-residents; an IC benefits from a complete statutory exemption on offshore interest and royalty payments. Under the Samoa-Australia DTA, reduced treaty caps generally apply to interest and royalties at 10% and to dividends at 15% (5% for qualifying shareholdings), subject to submission of the TRC and treaty relief documentation.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory WST-denominated Local File or Master File threshold exists in Samoa. The Income Tax Act 2015 imposes an arm's length standard on all cross-border related-party transactions of resident taxpayers, but a tax-exempt IC is outside the resident taxpayer net and has no transfer pricing documentation obligation. The IC must, however, preserve general business records (survey contracts, inspection reports, fee invoices, and bank statements) for at least 7 years, which the Commissioner may examine if the exemption is challenged.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa does not apply Caribbean-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR), but it enforces an equivalent offshore-substance regime under the International Companies Act 2008: an IC must not carry on business with Samoan residents, must not derive Samoan-source income, and must maintain a Resident Agent and registered office in Samoa. Consistent with Samoa's OECD/G20 BEPS and Global Forum commitments, a marine insurance surveyor IC must demonstrate genuine activity — actual hull and cargo damage inspection contracts with foreign underwriters, qualified survey staff or subcontractors, professional indemnity coverage, and real performance of claims assessments. A bare paper entity that merely invoices underwriting commissions without operational capacity will be re-characterized as a resident company and taxed at 27%.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion through Abusive Tax-Exempt Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting physical marine hull and cargo damage inspections inside Samoa, servicing Samoan policyholders or local underwriters, or deriving Samoan-source survey fees while retaining tax-exempt IC status and filing no income tax return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Re-characterization of the IC as a resident company; re-assessment of the entire income at 27% CIT with 15% dividend WHT on deemed distributions; penalties of up to 200% of the unpaid tax under the Tax Administration Act 2015; criminal fines of up to WST 500,000 and imprisonment for up to 7 years for the responsible officers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the Resident Agent are jointly and severally liable for the underpaid tax and penalties; the Commissioner may obtain civil restitution orders, freeze corporate and personal bank accounts, and impose travel bans preventing departure from Samoa pending resolution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the marine insurance surveyor IC as a paper conduit: no office, no survey equipment, no professional indemnity insurance, no qualified surveyors, and no actual performance of inspections — merely invoicing underwriters for commissions and holding funds in a Samoan IC bank account.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Striking-off and dissolution under the International Companies Act 2008; loss of tax exemption with back-assessment of 27% CIT and all withholding taxes; disqualification of directors for up to 5 years; monetary penalties of up to WST 100,000 under the International Companies Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under the fraudulent trading and veil-piercing provisions of the International Companies Act 2008, courts may declare directors and shadow controllers personally liable for all debts and restitution; asset tracing orders and travel bans may issue.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Acting as a marine claims surveyor, claims adjuster, or loss assessor without the statutory license required by the Insurance Act and the Samoa Financial Services Authority, or accepting underwriter wire payments and cash settlements without customer due diligence, beneficial ownership verification, or suspicious-transaction reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines of up to WST 1,000,000 for body corporates and imprisonment of up to 10 years for individuals under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007; revocation of the surveying license; closure of the IC's bank accounts; the remuneration derived is forfeitable as proceeds of a predicate offense.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the appointed AML/CFT compliance officer face personal criminal liability, fines, imprisonment, confiscation orders against personal assets, and travel bans or international arrest where cross-border wire proceeds are involved.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Annual Return and False Offshore Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omission of the Form ICA-9 annual return and annual fee for two consecutive years, or a false Box 7 declaration confirming offshore exclusivity while the company actually performs surveys in Samoa or for Samoan-domiciled insured cargo.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic striking-off under the International Companies Act 2008; restoration only by court order with payment of all arrears, reinstatement fees, and interest; false declarations attract criminal penalties of fine and imprisonment under the Crimes Act 2013 and the International Companies Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: During the struck-off period the company is dissolved and its assets vest in the State; directors who continue trading are personally liable for all contracts and debts, and the Resident Agent may be delisted where collusion in a false declaration is proven.
